_readme.purpose: Standing catalyst calendar. Holds dated events the earnings API does NOT provide: investor/analyst days, conferences, product launches, sales/delivery reports, FDA action dates, splits, shareholder meetings, filing deadlines, and macro speaking events. Routine earnings are pulled live from the earnings calendar and do not belong here.
consumed_by: daily premarket report - today's entries feed the game plan, next 5 days feed the This Week EVENTS column
Sunday week-ahead page - full following-week view
rules: time is 12-hour Central Time, or null when only the date is known
verified=true requires a real source URL; verified=false renders as tentative, never as fact
never add an entry without a source - omit it instead
Significance to the ticker is the bar, not event category. No filing deadlines, no routine conference appearances, no filler. If it cannot move the name, it does not go in.

Scope is the universe list plus market-wide macro. Do NOT add off-universe tickers just because they crossed a newsletter - if an off-universe name has a genuinely huge catalyst, add it deliberately and say why.

AMENDED 2026-08-17: market cap earns consideration on its own. A large-cap off-universe name gets evaluated on merit rather than auto-rejected for not being on the list. Pull the real cap before judging - do not eyeball it. Cap alone is not sufficient though: weigh it against event-type signal, where monthly sales/results releases and analyst days are high signal, plain conference appearances are low, and annual shareholder MEETINGS are near-zero regardless of cap.
Entries with no announced date use date:null plus a date_window string. Never assign a placeholder date to an undated event.
_readme.fields: ticker | name | type | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | time_ct | note | source | verified

events.name: Schlumberger
events.note: 31st annual EnerCom Denver - The Energy Investment Conference, Aug 17-19 at The Westin Denver Downtown. Largest independent investor conference serving oil & gas; 70+ presenting companies across E&P, oil service, midstream, royalty, AND nuclear/power/data center/hydrogen. Monday is the charity golf tournament - company presentations and 1x1s run Tue 8/18 and Wed 8/19. Matters as a sector event more than a single-name one: BP, APA, SM, LBRT, DNOW, WTTR, TXO, GTE, BKV, REPX, PROP, REI, SD, GRNT, BSM, FTK, E, VTS and ~20 more are all presenting in the same window, so the energy complex can move together. Secondary read-through to GEV and VRT from the nuclear/power/data-center track.

events.name: NVIDIA
events.note: Q2 FY2027. Results expected ~1:20pm PT (3:20pm CT), conference call 2:00pm PT (4:00pm CT). CFO written commentary posts immediately after the results release. Lands the day BEFORE Jackson Hole opens. Stored here despite being earnings because the earnings API carries no times. SEQUENCING NOTE added 2026-08-24: July PCE, core PCE and the Q2 GDP second estimate all release the SAME morning at 7:30am CT. The session therefore carries the Fed's preferred inflation gauge before the open and the largest single-name print of the month after the close, with Jackson Hole opening the next day.

events.name: Jackson Hole Economic Policy Symposium
events.note: Runs Aug 27-29 (Thu-Sat) at Jackson Lake Lodge. 2026 theme: 'Financial Innovation: Implications for Payments and Policy.' MATERIALLY BIGGER THAN A NORMAL YEAR: this is new Fed Chair KEVIN WARSH's FIRST Jackson Hole speech - a first-ever policy framing from a new Chair, not a routine reiteration. SPEECH DAY CONFIRMED 2026-08-24: Warsh delivers his first keynote as Chair on FRIDAY AUG 28. Week-ahead coverage names Friday explicitly; he is expected to have to address inflation directly, two days after the July PCE print lands Wednesday 8/26. TWO CORRECTIONS LOGGED: (1) an earlier entry had this as Aug 22 based on the FlowMS newsletter - the KC Fed date is Aug 27-29 and the verified date held; (2) the speaker was previously recorded as Powell - FlowMS issued its own correction 2026-08-17 naming Warsh as the new Chair.
events.source: https://www.kansascityfed.org/research/jackson-hole-economic-symposium/ ; Friday keynote day confirmed via week-ahead coverage 2026-08-24

events.name: Apple
events.note: CEO TRANSITION TAKES EFFECT. John Ternus, SVP of Hardware Engineering, becomes CEO; Tim Cook becomes executive chairman of the board; Arthur Levinson, non-executive chairman for the past 15 years, becomes lead independent director. Announced April 2026 and unanimously approved by the board, so the news is old but THE EFFECTIVE DATE IS 9/1 - this is Apple's first CEO transition since Cook succeeded Jobs in 2011. Cook stays on to engage with policymakers. A scheduled, known-date leadership change on a $4.5T company is a different animal from an earnings surprise: the event is certain, only the reaction is not.

recurring_patterns._note: Schedulable without per-event research. Dates still confirmed against IR before they go in events[].
recurring_patterns.COST: Monthly sales report, released AFTER THE CLOSE, in the first week or so of the following month. Confirmed pattern from Costco IR: Sept 2025 sales reported Oct 8; Oct 2025 sales reported Nov 5. So Aug 2026 sales land early Sept, Sept 2026 sales land early Oct. Exact dates are not pre-announced far ahead - check investor.costco.com in the final week of each month.
recurring_patterns.TSLA: Quarterly vehicle production/delivery report, first days of Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct, premarket.
recurring_patterns.RIVN: Quarterly production/delivery report, early in the month following quarter-end.
recurring_patterns.GM: Quarterly US sales, first business day after quarter-end.
